name: Woodside Apartments
use: Upper-division and 19+ apartments: 99 two-bedroom, four-person units in buildings A–R (392–400 students)

renovations.what: Mechanical-room ventilation upgrades put out to bid (July 2025)

facts.text: Opened in fall 1983 as the first undergraduate apartment complex on campus; called the Undergraduate Apartment Complex until a student naming contest in the early 1990s.
Buildings A through R each hold four or six two-bedroom apartments with living-room furniture, full kitchen appliances and 1 to 1½ baths.
The complex has a community center with mailroom, on-site parking, laundry and an outdoor volleyball court, in a forested area near the Whittemore Center.
UNH's packing list for Woodside suggests bringing a fan; no A/C or elevator is listed.

s4.title: UNH Woodside Mechanical Room Ventilation Upgrades (bid notice, published 2025-07-29)

verdict: 1983 gabled brick apartment clusters in the woods, the first undergraduate apartments: practical, no A/C, slow maintenance.
notes: One record covers all notunh parts (Woodside Building ABC, DEF, GHI, JKL, LMN, OPQ and the Woodside Community Building). UNH says 'buildings A through R' while notunh groups only through Q; check the map. Housing page gives both 392 (complex size) and 400/99 apartments (description) and 98 four-person units in its table. Architect unknown. Ventilation work is a bid notice only. Old row said residents may not bring A/C units; not re-verified. Photos: low two-storey brown-brick buildings with hipped shingle roofs in pine woods around a lawn and sand volleyball court; plain, domestic, pleasant setting.
